purpose: Physically validate Computer Use P1A acquisition of one ephemeral primary-display visual frame through the external, already physically validated Computer Control display.capture boundary.
requiredClaims: Computer Use receives VISUAL_FRAME_ACQUIRED from the real Computer Control display.capture path
the returned payload is canonical PNG with exact byteCount and positive image dimensions
frame coordinateSpace remains capture-pixel with top-left origin
interpretation remains NOT_RUN with zero candidates
Computer Use declares the frame EPHEMERAL and does not persist it
session evidence does not log dataBase64 or decoded image bytes
Computer Use and Computer Control git worktrees remain clean after the physical call
nonClaims: no OCR or vision interpretation is validated
capture-pixel coordinates are not claimed to equal Computer Control logical pointer coordinates
no pointer, keyboard, drag or wheel action is performed
the screenshot is not semantic proof of application state
